NOTE
**Still not ready: screenshots are fixed, but the approach is still undecided**

New: The author added before/after screenshots to the PR description, which answers the feedback. There is no new push. Missing: Sahil Batra's last CZO comment asked for the API to accept any casing and map it to the canonical language, while this PR rejects capitals, and the author said they'd follow whichever is chosen. The whole change is also one large commit across 14 files.

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and ask Sahil Batra to settle the approach on CZO; once it's settled and the commits are split, hand off for maintainer review with him assigned.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for adding the before/after screenshots, they look good. Before this can be reviewed, please settle the approach with Sahil on the CZO thread (reject capitals vs. accept any casing and normalize), and then split the work into smaller coherent commits following the [commit discipline guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/commit-discipline.html).
```
